messages:
leo_csm: Quick flag  we have an activation gap affecting ~22 onboarding tenants during 04:15-04:48 UTC on 2026-04-12. I'm marking 3 customers as renewal-risk for follow-up. Need a short external update + office hours invite and a validation checklist we can send.

tina_cs: Thanks Leo. Any Dedicated pools in the set? That will change how we phrase credits. :spiral_calendar: 

sre_bot: [incident created] INC-2026-0412-02 | sev=2 | owner=@mike_sre | tags=[ingest, activation-gap, replay]

mike_sre: Initial triage: ingestion workers experienced a backpressure event when a downstream shard entered long compaction/GC, causing acknowledgements to stall. Ingest workers retried and built up a backlog; replay pipeline delayed some writes. This hit shared onboarding pipelines harder than isolated Dedicated flows, but a few Dedicated tenants with cross-shard writes were slowed.

ela_infra: Quick datapoints: ingest_queue_size peaked at 210 (baseline ~22). Replayer throughput after fix = ~1.2k docs/s. No ongoing retries; tail latency still slightly elevated for large batches.

mike_sre: Action taken: we pushed a shard-side compaction guard and a short ingest-throttle at 1901234705. Replay jobs kicked off at 1901234710. Current replay progress ~60% for affected tenants.

leo_csm: Draft external note (concise). Please edit: ```We encountered an activation gap that delayed onboarding writes for a subset of tenants between 04:1504:48 UTC on 2026-04-12. Cause: transient downstream compaction and ingestion backpressure led to delayed acknowledgements, which slowed activations for some accounts. What we did: applied a compaction guard, throttled ingestion to prevent amplification, and replayed missed batches. Status: replays are ~60% complete; most customers are processing normally. Next steps: full replay expected within 6 hours; office hours at 18:30 UTC today to review impact and next steps (link). Compensation: eligible customers will receive a pro-rated onboarding credit equal to the number of days delayed; CS will follow up with impacted accounts.```

tina_cs: Nice. Add a validation checklist for customers: (1) confirm expected doc counts (run below), (2) run a canonical smoke query for your app, (3) check last_indexed_at timestamps on a sample doc. Include this command snippet: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/indexes/<index_id>/stats | jq .doc_count```

ela_infra: Evidence for postmortem: compaction pause traces + ingest_ack latency histogram attached in the postmortem draft. Root cause summary: long compaction pause on a subset of index shards + no early backpressure on ingest -> backlog/replay. Fix = compaction guard + ingest-throttle + replay idempotency checks. Full postmortem ETA EOD 2026-04-12.

sre_bot: [update] INC-2026-0412-02 | mitigation=compaction_guard,ingest_throttle | replay_progress=60% | status=monitoring

leo_csm: Tina  please send the revised external note to the affected list and CC me. I'll own the renewal-risk outreach for the 3 flagged accounts and coordinate credits. We'll capture feedback in the office hours and surface any ask to the postmortem.

tina_cs: Sending now to affected tenants, office hours link included. I'll post an internal-only thread listing the accounts we messaged and next steps for renewal-risk customers.

mike_sre: Monitoring; will alert CS if any replay jobs fall behind >8h.

ela_infra: I'll drop the compaction trace and a short log excerpt into the postmortem for CS reference.

leo_csm: Thanks everyone.
